stemMd:
What was a firm’s monthly profit, defined as revenue minus all costs?

(1) Monthly revenue was 12,000 euros.

(2) All monthly costs totalled 9,000 euros.

Which assessment of sufficiency is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Together the statements are sufficient, but neither is sufficient alone.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Even together the statements are not sufficient.

explanationMd: Revenue alone leaves costs unknown; costs alone leave revenue unknown. Together they determine profit as 12,000 minus 9,000 = 3,000 euros. Neither statement alone fixes the requested difference.

distractorRationale.a: Assess each statement separately before combining them. Revenue alone leaves costs unknown; costs alone leave revenue unknown. Together they determine profit as 12,000 minus 9,000 = 3,000 euros. Neither statement alone fixes the requested difference.
